retirement_age.notes: Social Security full retirement age is 67 for people born in 1960 or later; it is 66 for those born 1943-1954 and rises in two-month steps to 66 years 10 months for those born 1955-1959. Benefits can be claimed from age 62 with a reduction. Medicare eligibility remains at 65.
